fields.Institution: BML Munjal University – School of Management
fields.Approval / Accreditation: UGC private university; AACSB; AICTE where applicable
fields.Intake — Published:
310 sanctioned two-year PG intake (official NIRF 2026 submission)
Published numeric intake: 310
fields.Fees — Published:
Official MBA tuition ₹15.10 L: ₹7.55 L each year. One-time registration ₹35,000 gives ₹15.45 L nonrefundable academic charges. Refundable security ₹25,000 and hostel extra.
Numeric fee reference ₹L: 15.45
fields.Fee Scope: Two-year tuition plus one-time registration. Refundable ₹25,000 security excluded. Hostel with food costs ₹2.30–2.45 L per academic year, depending on occupancy.
fields.Accepted Exams: CAT, NMAT, GMAT, CMAT, XAT, GRE. Current programme overview specifies entrance examination plus personal interview.
fields.CAT / Exam Cutoff: No current official minimum entrance-test percentile located; the inherited expected 70–85 percentile is withdrawn.
fields.Eligibility: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline with at least 50%, per the current official MBA overview.
fields.Selection Process: Holistic review of entrance examination and profile; shortlisted applicants attend personal interview. University lists CAT/NMAT/GRE/GMAT/CMAT/XAT or BMU-MAT on postgraduate admissions page.
fields.Avg CTC — Published: No verified overall mean for the 2024–26 MBA cohort. Inherited ₹9.30 L was wrongly attributed to an official chart and is withdrawn. A 2025 official marketing blog quotes ₹9.2 L without a graduating cohort.
fields.Median CTC — Published:
₹8.12 LPA (2024–25 graduating cohort, official NIRF submission)
Reported median ₹L: 8.12
fields.Highest CTC — Published:
₹17 L highest, MBA 2024–26, official placement statistics. Top 10% mean ₹14.69 L and top 25% mean ₹12.43 L are subset figures, not the overall mean.
Reported highest ₹L: 17
fields.Placement — Published: Approximately 90% MBA placement, 2024–26, per official statistics. Placed/eligible headcounts not stated.
fields.Placement Scope: MBA 2024–26: highest ₹17 L and approximately 90% placement, without published headcounts. Top-10% mean ₹14.69 L and top-25% mean ₹12.43 L are subset statistics. NIRF median ₹8.12 L relates to 2024–25 graduates.
fields.Top Recruiters: Amazon; KPMG; DBS; Axis Bank; Hero; Accenture; Adani(official MBAcomparisonblog)
fields.Official Role Examples: Business Data Analyst; Digital Transformation Consultant; HR Analytics Specialist; AI Product Manager; Financial Analyst. Official career examples, not verified graduating-cohort roles.
fields.Programme-Aligned Career Paths: Business/Strategy Consultant; Product/Program Manager; Operations; Sales/Brand; Finance Analyst
fields.Ranking: NIRF Management 2025: rank 77 (official university programme page)
fields.Notes: Official MBA 2024–26 highest ₹17 L and approximately 90% placed verified. Top 10% ₹14.69 L and top 25% ₹12.43 L are not whole means. Undated cohort ₹9.2 L mean appears only in a 2025 official blog.
fields.Fee Evidence: Official both-year tuition schedule plus registration. Previous ₹14.30 L total withdrawn.
fields.Average Evidence: Both official charts show highest CTC and top-10%/top-25% subset means only. They do not substantiate an overall ₹9.30 L mean. The separately reported NIRF median ₹8.12 L retains its 2024–25 scope.
fields.Intake Evidence: Previously published; year / programme scope applies
fields.Current Audit Note: 18 Oct 2026 public-source review. Checked: Both-year tuition and one-time registration, Graduate eligibility, MBA 2024–26 highest ₹17 L and top-student subset means, Approximate placement statement without headcounts. Both-year tuition, registration and eligibility verified. Visual inspection of the 2023–25 and 2024–26 charts found no overall ₹9.30 L mean; that inherited actual is withdrawn. Top-student means are separate; NIRF median keeps its prior stated cohort.
